name: N'Kari
canonNotes: A Keeper of Secrets and Slaanesh's favoured daemon, eternally obsessed with vengeance on Aenarion's line and on the Everqueen.
voiceNotes: Silken, seductive and mocking; every sentence a temptation.
Obsessed with Ulthuan; delights in others' desires.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
